description: Testbench inventory for sky130-droop-detector. Spec rows (spec/target-spec.md): 1 sim/tb_rail_model_check; 2 sim/tb_supply_headroom; 3 sim/tb_ref_droop; 4 sim/tb_threshold_select; 5 sim/tb_threshold_accuracy (corner grid; device-mismatch Monte Carlo tb_threshold_mc is item 6, #35); 6 sim/tb_latency; 7 sim/tb_min_width; 8 sim/tb_false_flag; 9 sim/tb_filter; 10 sim/tb_flag_logic + verification/flag_logic; 11 sim/tb_iq; sim/tb_comparator is the comparator-only bench behind rows 5-6. Cold start: sim/run_all.sh (optional PDK_ROOT; writes no records). Each bench is one corner (tt / 27 C / 3.3 V by default); the corner box is #34.
